achievements.name: First Capture
achievements.detail: Throw Cappy onto a creature or object and move around as that form.

achievements.name: Power Moon
achievements.detail: Collect a Power Moon and send it back to the Odyssey.

achievements.name: Kingdom Cleared
achievements.detail: Finish a kingdom's story moons and fly the Odyssey on to the next land.

achievements.name: Madame Broode
achievements.detail: Defeat Madame Broode and Chain Chompikins on the Cascade cliffs.

achievements.name: Crazy Cap
achievements.detail: Buy a new outfit for Mario from a Crazy Cap shop.

achievements.name: Regional Coins
achievements.detail: Collect a kingdom's local coins and spend them where only that currency works.

achievements.name: City Festival
achievements.detail: Help New Donk City put on its festival and celebrate on the rooftop stage.

achievements.name: Jump-Rope Streak
achievements.detail: Jump rope in New Donk City long enough to earn the Power Moon for a long streak.

achievements.name: Hint Art
achievements.detail: Read a Hint Art painting, then find the Power Moon it points to in another kingdom.

achievements.name: Coin Moon
achievements.detail: Buy a kingdom's Power Moon at Crazy Cap for a hundred regular coins.

achievements.name: Moon Ceremony
achievements.detail: Break into the Moon Kingdom ceremony and rescue Peach from Bowser.

achievements.name: Castle Grounds
achievements.detail: Visit the Mushroom Kingdom and collect a Power Moon on the grounds of Peach's Castle.

achievements.name: Darker Side
achievements.detail: Clear the final extra kingdom, which opens only after a huge Power Moon haul.
